context: A teacher walks a class through a chart of population changes
purpose: Teach: グラフ/気候/減る/追わ/抜い/役者/曖昧/フェア

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: では皆さん、このグラフを見てください。日本の人口推移を表しています。
lines.en: Alright everyone, please look at this graph. It shows Japan's population trends.
lines.style: Teacher addresses class in calm, clear lecturing tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、二〇一〇年あたりから人口が減っているのが、はっきり分かりますね。
lines.en: Professor, you can clearly see the population starts to decrease around 2010.
lines.style: University student answers attentively with respectful curiosity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。出生率も減るし、地方では特に若者が都市に流出しています。
lines.en: Exactly. Birth rates are dropping, and rural areas especially lose young people to cities.
lines.style: Teacher explains with steady, informative classroom delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 気候の変化も移住の理由になりますか?最近の猛暑とか…
lines.en: Does climate change also become a reason for migration? Like the recent extreme heat...
lines.style: Student raises a thoughtful follow-up question politely.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い質問です。ただ、その影響はまだ曖昧で、データだけでは結論を出しにくいですね。
lines.en: Good question. However, that impact is still ambiguous and hard to conclude from data alone.
lines.style: Teacher responds approvingly then qualifies academically.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。この赤い線が中国に抜かれた時期ですよね?確か二〇〇〇年代に追い抜いて…
lines.en: I see. This red line marks when China overtook us, right? They surpassed us in the 2000s...
lines.style: Student points at chart, thinking aloud while reasoning.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 正確には、中国が日本を抜いたのはもっと前です。数字をきちんと追わないと誤解しますよ。
lines.en: Actually China surpassed Japan even earlier. You'll misread it if you don't follow the numbers properly.
lines.style: Teacher gently corrects with patient instructional tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: すみません。ニュースのコメンテーターや役者の発言を鵜呑みにしていました…
lines.en: I'm sorry. I was just swallowing what news commentators and TV personalities said whole...
lines.style: Student admits mistake with sheepish, self-critical honesty.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 比較はフェアにね。一次資料を確認する習慣をつけましょう。来週も続きます。
lines.en: Keep comparisons fair, okay? Build the habit of checking primary sources. We continue next week.
lines.style: Teacher closes lesson warmly with encouraging final advice.
